integrity: All characteristic statements have a universal coefficientwise algebraic proof. Symbolic tests are reproducibility support, not independent certification. The nilpotent structure and Plucker twist use the specified embedding.
scientific_limitations: Only the quadratic Veronese surface cone in \(\mathbb P^6\), with algebraically closed ground field; no classification of higher cones. Historical priority remains provisional against the unavailable Ballico-Cossidente 2000 text and other unindexed literature.
title: The Fano scheme of a Veronese cone is a split cotangent thickening
